laat_vaar.voor: Noem 'n baken by elke stap en die naam van die pad as die pad een het.
laat_vaar.na: Noem by elke stap 'n baken en ook die naam van die pad as dit een het.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The repeated 'die pad' is wooden, and the word order lets 'by elke stap en die naam' be misread as one phrase; moving 'by elke stap' forward and adding 'ook' keeps the meaning (no comma, since it is one sentence).
laat_vaar.fout: none; the repeated 'die pad' is deliberate and the sentence reads clearly enough for Grade 4
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The proposal replaces 'die pad' with 'dit', which can point to the landmark (or the step) instead of the road, so the meaning blurs; the word-order change and added 'ook' are only a lateral gain and do not justify that ambiguity.
